CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/presentation description, and an origin/status field are all explicitly present and bind to p0/current/n3.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to specific content presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-identification lines list named referents and their attributed coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is provided separately from the listed content positions for the same referent, distinguishing identity from status/metadata.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states how the grid is organized and presents coordinate patterns for specific referents.
